workload.weights: actual layer-1 resident Q4_K T16 gate/up tensors
workload.timing: 5 warmups, 21 counterbalanced samples, 50 launches per sample
workload.candidate: one BF16-to-Q8_1 pack launch plus selected Q4_K T16 dp4a fused-SiLU launch

analysis.finding: Widening Q8_1 d/s metadata from FP16 to FP32 does not change a single candidate BF16 output at this selected gate/up seam. It therefore cannot repair the previously rejected full-model one-plane Q8_1 quality result.
analysis.speed_premise: Reusable Q8_1 packing plus integer dot remains a real performance mechanism: both inclusive two-launch candidates beat the exact leaf by more than 22%. The missing piece is quantization error correction, not scale-storage range or precision.

decision.reason: The proposed F32 scale/sum metadata produces exactly the same approximate BF16 output while being slower than the compact FP16-scale block in this screen.
decision.next_reopen_condition: A bounded residual or mixed exact/quantized scheme that changes the Q8 activation approximation itself and passes the full decode KL/top-1 gate.
